info.title: StockSmart inventory API
info.description: Inventory, suppliers, public scraped prices and order receipt API. JWT roles, persisted suggestions and human decisions. No automatic purchases.

alert_status.title: Alert Status
alert_status.description: IN_TRANSIT: low stock already attended by an approved order not yet received.

required_quantity.title: Required Quantity
required_quantity.description: Theoretical need; action is zero in transit.

lead_time_days.title: Lead Time Days
lead_time_days.description: Longest delivery time (calendar days) among active suppliers; null if none.

projected_stock_at_arrival.title: Projected Stock At Arrival
projected_stock_at_arrival.description: Stock minus expected consumption during delivery; may be negative (RN-07).

in_transit_quantity.title: In Transit Quantity
in_transit_quantity.description: Base-unit quantity in approved orders not yet received.

order_by_at.title: Order By At
order_by_at.description: Latest moment to order so it arrives before falling to the safe stock. A past value means the order is overdue.

note.title: Note
examples: Salida duplicada; conteo posterior ya la absorbió

stock_effect.title: Stock Effect
stock_effect.description: Signed effect in the item's base unit, applied now. Zero documents an error already absorbed by a count; a nonzero value corrects only current stock.

manual_safe_stock.title: Manual Safe Stock
manual_safe_stock.description: Send null to restore the automatic threshold; omit to leave it unchanged.

ItemUpdate.title: ItemUpdate
ItemUpdate.description: Partial update. Only the fields sent are changed; the base unit cannot change.

occurred_at.title: Occurred At
occurred_at.description: Actual occurrence time; omitted means now. Timezone-aware.

balance_after.title: Balance After
balance_after.description: Item stock right after this movement, in order of occurrence (occurred_at, created_at, id).

created_by.description: Author; null only for legacy/imported records.

received_quantity.title: Received Quantity
received_quantity.description: Measured base-unit weight for variable-weight packs; full receipt only.

manual_safe_stock.title: Manual Safe Stock
manual_safe_stock.description: Set a nonnegative manual threshold; null restores the automatic threshold.
